The file lists the director (unit vector of average molecular orientation, n equivalent to −n) at sites along the helix axis of a model cholesteric liquid-crystal film; columns are site x y z (nm) nx ny nz. Model conditions: the only measured inputs are those reported by Shaban et al. (Materials 2024) for the nematic host E44 doped with the chiral dopant R5011 or S5011: the helical twisting power (107.5 μm⁻¹), the dopant concentration and the host refractive indices (ne = 1.7904, no = 1.5484 at 589 nm, 20 °C); the director twists uniformly about a straight helix axis (ideal planar Grandjean texture) with no defects, surface-anchoring distortion or temperature gradient, which is the idealization behind the paper's relations p = 1/(HTP·c) and λc = p·(ne + no)/2. Each file samples the director every 5 nm over 1.5 μm along an arbitrarily oriented axis. At normal incidence, what is the central wavelength λc of the selective (Bragg) reflection band, in nm? Use the average refractive index (ne + no)/2 of the host and its birefringence ne − no.

选项：
A. 296.4 nm
B. 355.1 nm
C. 549.8 nm
D. 592.7 nm

附件：clc-E44-R5011-2.62wt.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文参数构建的理想胆甾螺旋指向矢场（每 5 nm 一点，1.5 μm，确定性取向）；不是实测结构；模型反射与实测相差约 1–2%。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
